# wisp-science v1.24.0 — Setup and Remote

**Wisp can install missing uv, Python, R and Node for you, and your phone can reach the desktop without a server of your own.** User-level instructions, MCP servers and skills can live in `~/.wisp`. The right pane opens on a tool home, Agent workflows show live progress, and a cause of conversations stuck at "waiting for the model" is removed.

## Install into Wisp

- The local environment panel (first-run setup, **Settings → General**, **Capabilities**) uses the uv, Python, R and Node it detects and offers to install only the missing ones into Wisp's own folder, or to skip for now.
- Installs use a pinned pixi checked against its release SHA-256 and stay under Wisp's app data; `~/.pixi` is never touched. Python brings uv, which creates Wisp's Python environment. Your proxy, Conda mirror, Python index and CA bundle settings apply. Progress is shown live, and an install can be stopped and retried. Nothing runs at startup.
- Local shell commands, Runs and hooks find Wisp's Python environment and installed tools first on `PATH`, so projects can create their own environments with uv.
- Background environment detection results now reach the UI; previously they were dropped. See [basic configuration](https://github.com/xuzhougeng/wisp-science/blob/v1.24.0/docs/basic-configuration.md).

## User-level configuration in ~/.wisp

- `~/.wisp/AGENTS.md` is added to the prompt as user instructions, before the project's `AGENTS.md` and `.wisp/WISP.md`, which take precedence. Editing it marks desktop sessions as needing a rules reload.
- `~/.wisp/skills` is a global skill folder; symlinked skill folders are followed, and a broken link is reported as a catalog error. The CLI now loads skills from the same scopes as the desktop.
- `~/.wisp/mcp.json` (`mcpServers` format) adds stdio and Streamable HTTP MCP servers, with `${NAME}` and `${NAME:-default}` expansion from the environment. SSE servers, unknown types and unset variables are reported per server; servers marked disabled are skipped. Values are never stored in SQLite or the keyring.
- The Magpie connection now sends each conversation's ID, so Wisp conversations appear on Magpie's Sessions page. See [skills](https://github.com/xuzhougeng/wisp-science/blob/v1.24.0/docs/skills.md) and [Magpie](https://github.com/xuzhougeng/wisp-science/blob/v1.24.0/docs/magpie.md).

## Remote access without a server

- A Cloudflare Workers edition of the relay can be deployed with one button from `crates/wisp-sync/cloudflare`, within the Workers Free plan. Enter the Worker URL and token on the desktop as with the self-hosted relay. It serves remote access only; project sync and Wisp Lab still need the binary relay. Where `workers.dev` is blocked, use a custom domain.
- **Settings → Remote access** shows the connection link as a QR code. The iPhone and Android apps can scan it from their connection screen; Android scanning works without Google Play services. The QR code is the password, so show it only to your own phone. See [remote access](https://github.com/xuzhougeng/wisp-science/blob/v1.24.0/docs/remote-access.md).

## Right pane and Agents

- The right pane opens on a browser-style tool home with common tools and a **More tools** group. Every tool has a home action, and only the tools you open appear as tabs; the four default tabs no longer come back when you reopen the pane.
- Running Agent workflows show total, running, completed, waiting and failed task counts with a segmented progress meter. Animations stop when reduced motion is on.

## Reliability

- An oversized tool result is saved to `.wisp/tool-output/` off the turn's thread, waiting at most 5 seconds; past that the model gets the excerpt without a file reference. Restoring long history and project database checks no longer block the turn either. This targets conversations stuck at "waiting for the model" with "Timed out loading the live transcript", where Stop could not end the turn. A flush timeout now names the stalled writer in the log.
- The browser extension banners show the extension path and step-by-step "Load unpacked" instructions. On macOS they say to press ⌘⇧G in Chrome's folder picker, because it cannot browse into the hidden `~/Library`. See [real browser automation](https://github.com/xuzhougeng/wisp-science/blob/v1.24.0/docs/real-browser-automation.md).

## SwiftUI client (macOS)

- Added the Runs and Memos tabs to the right panel, the decision model tab in model settings, the default subagent model in Specialists settings, and per-project switches and status on plugin rows.
- The sidebar and top bar fold the way the WebView does, settings use WebView-style switches and number steppers, and the transcript follows a running turn smoothly.
- The cold-start query timeout now explains itself, folder access is declared, and a check keeps untranslated English out of the Chinese interface.

## Downloads

- **macOS**: signed and notarized DMGs for Apple Silicon and Intel, with in-app updates for compatible installations. Separate SwiftUI DMGs and checksums are also published.
- **Windows**: MSI / NSIS installers and the separate WinUI 3 preview installers, signed with an SSL.com certificate.
- **Linux**: deb and AppImage packages for x86_64 and aarch64.
- **Mobile**: the signed [Android APK](https://github.com/xuzhougeng/wisp-science/releases/download/v1.24.0/wisp-science_1.24.0_android.apk) installs over the previous version. Install iOS through Xcode.
- **Relay image**: `ghcr.io/xuzhougeng/wisp-relay:1.24.0` and `:latest` for amd64 and arm64.

Desktop assets appear as the platform workflows finish.

[All changes since v1.23.0](https://github.com/xuzhougeng/wisp-science/compare/v1.23.0...v1.24.0)

# wisp-science v1.24.0 — 一键环境与远程接入

**Wisp 可以帮你安装缺少的 uv、Python、R 和 Node，手机也不再需要自建服务器就能连上桌面端。** 用户级的指令、MCP 服务器和技能可以放在 `~/.wisp`。右侧面板改为从工具首页打开，Agent 工作流显示实时进展，并消除了一个导致对话卡在「等待模型」的原因。

## 安装到 Wisp

- 本地环境面板（首次启动引导、**设置 → 通用**、**能力**）会直接使用检测到的 uv、Python、R 和 Node，只对缺少的工具提供「安装到 Wisp」，也可以先跳过。
- 安装使用固定版本的 pixi，解包前校验其发布 SHA-256，所有内容都放在 Wisp 的应用数据目录下，不会动 `~/.pixi`。安装 Python 时会一并装上 uv，并由它创建 Wisp 的 Python 环境。代理、Conda 镜像、Python 索引和 CA 证书设置都会生效。安装过程实时显示进度，可以停止和重试。启动时不会自动安装任何东西。
- 本地 shell 命令、Runs 和 hooks 会优先在 `PATH` 中找到 Wisp 的 Python 环境和已安装的工具，项目可以用 uv 创建自己的环境。
- 后台环境检测的结果现在能正确显示在界面上，此前会被丢掉。详见[基础配置](https://github.com/xuzhougeng/wisp-science/blob/v1.24.0/docs/basic-configuration.md)。

## ~/.wisp 中的用户级配置

- `~/.wisp/AGENTS.md` 会作为用户指令加入提示词，位于项目的 `AGENTS.md` 和 `.wisp/WISP.md` 之前，后两者优先。修改它后，桌面端会话会提示需要重载规则。
- `~/.wisp/skills` 是全局技能目录，支持符号链接的技能文件夹，失效的链接会作为技能目录错误报告。CLI 现在与桌面端从相同的范围加载技能。
- `~/.wisp/mcp.json`（`mcpServers` 格式）可添加 stdio 和 Streamable HTTP MCP 服务器，支持从环境变量展开 `${NAME}` 和 `${NAME:-default}`。SSE 服务器、未知类型和未设置的变量会按服务器逐个报错；标记为禁用的服务器会被跳过。其中的值不会存进 SQLite 或钥匙串。
- Magpie 连接现在会发送每个对话的 ID，Wisp 的对话会出现在 Magpie 的 Sessions 页面上。详见[技能](https://github.com/xuzhougeng/wisp-science/blob/v1.24.0/docs/skills.md)和 [Magpie](https://github.com/xuzhougeng/wisp-science/blob/v1.24.0/docs/magpie.md)。

## 无需服务器的远程访问

- 新增 Cloudflare Workers 版中继，可从 `crates/wisp-sync/cloudflare` 一键部署，Workers 免费套餐即可运行。在桌面端填入 Worker 地址和令牌，用法与自建中继相同。它只提供远程访问，项目同步和 Wisp Lab 仍需要二进制中继。`workers.dev` 无法访问的地区（中国大陆常被屏蔽）请使用自定义域名。
- **设置 → 远程接入**会把联机链接显示为二维码。iPhone 和 Android 应用可在连接页面用**扫描桌面二维码**直接连接；Android 扫码不依赖 Google Play 服务。二维码就是密码，只给自己的手机看。详见[远程访问](https://github.com/xuzhougeng/wisp-science/blob/v1.24.0/docs/remote-access.md)。

## 右侧面板与 Agents

- 右侧面板改为浏览器式的工具首页，分为常用工具和**更多工具**分组。每个工具都有返回首页的按钮，标签栏只显示你打开过的工具；重新打开面板时不会再冒出四个默认标签。
- 运行中的 Agent 工作流会显示任务总数以及运行中、已完成、等待中、失败的数量，并配有分段进度条。开启「减少动态效果」时动画会停止。

## 稳定性

- 过大的工具结果会在回合线程之外保存到 `.wisp/tool-output/`，最多等待 5 秒；超时则只把摘录交给模型，不附文件引用。恢复长历史和检查项目数据库也不再阻塞回合。这针对的是对话卡在「等待模型」、重试时提示「加载实时对话记录超时」、点停止也无法结束回合的问题。刷新超时时，日志会写明卡住的是哪个写入器。
- 浏览器扩展横幅会显示扩展路径和分步的「加载已解压的扩展程序」说明。macOS 上会提示在 Chrome 的文件夹选择框里按 ⌘⇧G，因为它无法直接浏览隐藏的 `~/Library`。详见[真实浏览器自动化](https://github.com/xuzhougeng/wisp-science/blob/v1.24.0/docs/real-browser-automation.md)。

## SwiftUI 客户端（macOS）

- 右侧面板新增运行和备忘录标签页，模型设置新增决策模型标签页，专家设置新增默认子智能体模型，插件行新增按项目的启用开关和状态。
- 侧栏和顶栏的折叠方式与 WebView 一致，设置页改用 WebView 风格的开关和数字步进器，运行中的回合在对话记录中滚动更平滑。
- 冷启动查询超时现在会说明原因，声明了文件夹访问权限，并新增检查，防止中文界面残留未翻译的英文。

## 下载

- **macOS**：Apple Silicon 与 Intel 的签名、公证 DMG，兼容安装支持应用内更新；另提供 SwiftUI 版 DMG 和校验文件。
- **Windows**：MSI / NSIS 安装包和独立的 WinUI 3 预览安装包，使用 SSL.com 证书签名。
- **Linux**：x86_64 与 aarch64 的 deb、AppImage 安装包。
- **移动端**：[签名 Android APK](https://github.com/xuzhougeng/wisp-science/releases/download/v1.24.0/wisp-science_1.24.0_android.apk) 可直接覆盖安装旧版本；iOS 通过 Xcode 安装。
- **中继镜像**：`ghcr.io/xuzhougeng/wisp-relay:1.24.0` 与 `:latest`，支持 amd64、arm64。

各平台流水线完成后，桌面安装包会陆续出现在附件中。
